caption: The drawing depicts a single cylindrical bucket made of what appears to be dark brown or black leather with visible stitching along the rim and base. The bucket has a matching leather handle attached to two metal loops on either side of the rim. There is a wide cream-colored horizontal band around the upper portion of the bucket which contains bold, uppercase black letters spelling out "HOPKI" (the rest of the word is partially cropped out of the frame). Below this, on the lower part of the bucket, is another curved cream-colored band with black letters spelling "HADDONFIEL," of which the last letter is partially cropped as well. The handle is padded and secured with metal rivets or possibly knots. The background of the drawing is a lightly mottled, beige color, and there is an artist's signature, "Carl Burgess," in the lower right-hand portion of the image.
title: Fire Bucket
